hero.headline: Support for Your Hall Titans
hero.body: Friends of Hall Football is the family and community run booster club behind your team. Your support pays for equipment, meals, team gear, and the moments these players will remember for the rest of their lives.

newsletterBand.heading: Read the Newsletter
newsletterBand.body: Team updates, player recognition, fundraiser dates, and everything happening around the program — sent out each quarter and always available to read online.

volunteer.heading: Lend a Hand
volunteer.body: No experience needed and no long commitment. Grill burgers, work the gate, run the concession stand, or help load equipment. Sign up for whatever fits your schedule.

volunteerPage.heading: Lend a Hand
volunteerPage.intro: Every home game and team event runs on parent and community volunteers. Pick a slot that works for you — all sign-ups go through SignUpGenius.
volunteerPage.closing: Do not see something that fits, or want to help in another way? Email us and we will find a spot for you.

donatePage.payNote: You will be taken to our secure Stripe checkout page, where you can pay by card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay. Friends of Hall Football never sees or stores your card number.
